Output: Capacity of road agencies enhanced. Indicator: By 2024: 1a. 65% overall financial progress achieved for improving about 3,108 km of rural access roads to all-weather standard incorporating road safety and EWCD-friendly features Achievement: N Progress/Status: Contracts awarded to improve 2,710 km of rural roads and 2,515 km completed. Performance Based Maintenance is in progress on the road section rehabilitation is completed. Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Indicator Indicator: 1b. 35% overall financial progress achieved for rehabilitating about 248 km of national roads incorporating road safety and EWCD-friendly features and maintained under performance-based contracts Achievement: N Progress/Status: 378 km national road awarded and 90 km completed. Procurement is ongoing for 32 km length national roads. Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Indicator Indicator: 1c. At least 15% of local maintenance workers are women Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Likely to be achieved Data Source: RDA project performance monitoring system Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: 2a. Program for skills transfer to provincial and local road agencies from RDA established and functioning Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Altogether 140 workshops, training and seminars were conducted. Out of this 70 are related to the capacity development of road agencies (RDA, PRDA and Local Authorities). Approximately 500 staff members benefited. Data Source: Capacity-building program reports Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2024 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
